meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Odysee: hides the featured banner and starfield, blurs or hides thumbnails and comments, can hide related videos and reactions
meta.notes:
**Checked 2026-11-13**, logged out, headless Chrome: https://odysee.com/ with an iPhone UA and a desktop UA, and one video page with an iPhone UA (the desktop capture of that page was an empty shell). Odysee is a React app with readable BEM-style class names.

- **Featured banner**: `.featured-banner-wrapper` 1 (5 slides) on both (LIVE).
- **Star field and backdrop**: `.main-wrapper > .stars` 1 and `.main-wrapper > .background-image` 1 (LIVE).
- **Thumbnails**: `.claim-preview--tile .media__thumb` 194 on desktop home, 194 on phone (LIVE); thumbnails are CSS background images, so the box is blurred or hidden.
- **Comments**: `section.comment__list` 1 on a video page (LIVE). The list loads by script after the page, so it was empty in the capture.
- **Related** `section.file-page__recommended` 1; **reactions** `.button-like` 2, `.button-dislike` 2, `.ratio-bar` 2 on a video page (LIVE).

Not verified: the desktop video page layout (capture was empty), channel pages, livestream pages, the monetisation prompts, the community "Premium" upsells, the `.nag--helpful` bottom banner reported in a 2022 community post (not rendered here). Logged-in features were not seen. No hashed class names are used.
